# Alvora Diamonds — full LLM feed

Alvora Diamonds is a laboratory-grown diamond business based in Surat, India.
It sells finished fine jewellery set with laboratory-grown diamonds (engagement
rings and earrings in 14K and 18K gold) to private customers through an
enquiry-first process, and supplies wholesale laboratory-grown diamonds for
jewellery retailers, manufacturers, designers, and other trade buyers,
including loose stones, calibrated layouts, matched pairs, melee, fancy shapes
and colours, and custom-cut requirements.

Growth methods: CVD and HPHT. Certification: IGI as standard; GIA on request.

## Current certified stock

As of 22 September 2026 the current index lists 3,185 certified stones:
3,151 IGI-certified and 34 GIA-certified. 1,195 stones have a 360 video.
Each stone has its own page with the lab report and video. Prices are agreed
on enquiry.

- White stones: colours D–G, plus fancy colours including pink, blue, yellow
  and green. The exact colour is stated on each stone's report.
- Fluorescence: None. All shipped stones are graded None by IGI.
- Lists include rounds under 1 ct through 3 ct+, ovals, pears, cushions,
  radiants, step cuts, fancy pink/blue/yellow, 3 ct+ white and fancy stones,
  and 10 ct+ showpieces.

## Jewellery (private customers)

- Home: lab-grown diamond engagement rings and fine jewellery — /

  /engagement-rings/shape/pear, /engagement-rings/shape/elongated-cushion,
  /engagement-rings/shape/old-mine and more
- Earrings: /earrings
- Necklaces and pendants: /necklaces
- Book a consultation: /book-a-consultation

Each piece is made to order. Centre stones run 0.5–6 ct at E colour, VS1
clarity; rounds are Excellent cut, fancy shapes Excellent polish and symmetry
(labs grade cut only on rounds). Rings are made in 925 sterling silver,
platinum, or solid 14K/18K gold in yellow, white or rose; earrings in solid
14K/18K gold. Nothing is made until the buyer confirms a written price and
timeline.

## Trade facts

- Minimum order: depends on product, size, shape, certification and whether
  the request is stock, a sample, a layout, or custom production.
  Category-specific minimums are confirmed in the quotation before approval.
- Sample or memo requests can be discussed before the first production order;
  memo terms are confirmed in writing before any goods ship.
- Lead time depends on whether the requirement is available stock, a selected
  layout or pair, melee sorting, certification, or custom cutting. Actual days
  by product are stated in the quotation.
- Shipping: courier shipment to the US, Canada, EU and GCC can be discussed,
  with insurance and applicable IGI paperwork. The buyer is responsible for
  destination-country duties, taxes and import clearance; confirm current
  rates with the relevant customs authority before shipment. US buyers receive
  tariff-inclusive quotes within the confirmed quotation scope.
- Quote response: within 24 hours on business days; same-day on WhatsApp
  during Surat hours (IST 09:00–19:00).
